text:
UK just DROPPED 🛬 a FAT 💦 sanctions REGIME 📜 on those ILLEGAL 🛑 Israeli SETTLEMENTS 🏠 in the occupied WEST 🧭 BANK 🏦 accusing Netanyahu's CREW 👥 of turning a BLIND 👀 eye to the "ETHNIC 🧬 CLEANSING 🧹" of PALESTINIANS 🇵🇸 by SETTLER 🤠 TERRORISTS 🧨!! Foreign Secretary ED 🍆 MILIBAND 🧔 (our favourite BRITISH 💂‍♂️ JEWISH 🕎 daddy who still LOVES ❤️ Israel but can't ignore the INJUSTICE ⚖️) called it the "BEGINNING 🌅 of a new APPROACH 🛣️" that doesn't just TALK 🗣️ about suffering but actually GETS 🫦 DOWN 🛐 and ACTS 💪!! Israel's Foreign Minister GIDEON 🛡️ SAAR clapped BACK 🔙 hard accusing him of spreading an "OUTRAGEOUS 🤬 LIE 🐂" and immediately ANNOUNCED 📢 counter MEASURES 🛠️ including SHUTTING 🚪 the UK's consulate 🏛️ in East Jerusalem like a dramatic EX 💔 who just got DUMPED 😭!!

The sanctions will BAN 🚫 settlement GOODS 🍇 but also go after COMPANIES 🏢 and INDIVIDUALS 🧍 providing SERVICES 🧰 for settlement EXPANSION 📈 which is basically the ISRAELI 🕎 government edging 🖐️ closer and closer to swallowing the whole WEST 🧭 BANK 🏦 while the world watches 😳!! Launched alongside FRANCE 🇫🇷 and CANADA 🇨🇦 in a joint STATEMENT 📝 that this marks a "TURNING 🌀 POINT 📍" in protecting that ever SHRINKING 🐌 two-state SOLUTION 🧩!! Settlements are straight up ILLEGAL 🚫 under international LAW ⚖️ and there's been a SPIKE 📈 in VIOLENCE 🩸 towards Palestinians by these SETTLERS 🏕️ in recent MONTHS 📆 with the UN 📍 defining ethnic cleansing as a purposeful POLICY 📋 to remove another group by VIOLENT 🔫 means!! ED 🍆 MILIBAND straight up said in the Commons that the British government AGREES ✅ there IS ethnic cleansing perpetrated by settler TERRORISTS 🧨 and that Israel has all too often turned a blind eye 👀 or WORSE 😬 with some ministers even SUPPORTING 🫶 the forced DISPLACEMENT 🚚 of Palestinians!!

He dropped that the official UK VIEW 👁️ is that the Israeli OCCUPATION 🪖 of the West Bank is UNLAWFUL 🚫 because of the ENTRENCHMENT 🕳️ of control its intention to extend PERMANENT 🏛️ sovereignty and that EXPANSIONIST 🗺️ agenda via illegal SETTLEMENTS 🏘️ which lines up perfectly with the 2024 International Court of Justice advisory OPINION 📜!! Over the next SIX 🔢 to NINE 🔢 months the UK will roll out a new COMPREHENSIVE 📦 sanctions REGIME 🎛️ targeting the settlements and their GROWTH 🌱 not Israel itself and also BANNING 📢 advertising of these illegal outposts in the UK like taking down their horny 📣 real estate SIGNS 🪧!! Prime Minister ANDY 🔥 BURNHAM later chimed in that these targeted measures are aimed NOT 🚫 at the Israeli people but in SUPPORT 🛡️ of that two-state SOLUTION 🧩 while the joint statement with ELEVEN 1️⃣1️⃣ other countries including DENMARK 🇩🇰 SPAIN 🇪🇸 and SWEDEN 🇸🇪 reaffirmed their commitment to the two-state PATH 🛤️ and promised national MEASURES 🛠️ or European restrictions on trading GOODS 🍓 with West Bank settlements!!

This all comes right after Israel opened TENDERS 📋 for constructing some ONE 💯 TWO 💯 ZERO ZERO new settlement HOMES 🏠 in the so-called E1 AREA 🗺️ a strategically IMPORTANT 🔑 spot east of Jerusalem that would literally CUT ✂️ through the heart of Palestine and make the two-state SOLUTION 🧩 completely UNVIABLE 🪦!! Plans that have drawn WIDESPREAD 🌍 international CONDEMNATION 😠 with Israel having HELD OFF ⏳ on building there for DECADES ⏳ under global PRESSURE 🗣️ but apparently now feeling BOLD 💪 enough to push ahead!! ED 🍆 MILIBAND stressed that while the Hamas-led ATTACK 🗡️ on southern Israel on 7 OCTOBER 📅 2023 carried terrible ECHOES 🪞 of centuries of persecution of the Jewish people and that Israel has every right to PROTECT 🛡️ its people the response in Gaza cannot JUSTIFY ⚖️ what has happened there with international humanitarian LAW 📜 imposing clear RULES 📏 including access to food 🥫 medical supplies 🚑 avoiding mass DISPLACEMENT 🏃‍♂️ of civilians and not targeting them!!

He pointed out that actions of the IDF 🪖 have been examined by multiple organisations including the UN 📍 Independent International Commission of Inquiry with conclusions showing INCREASING 📈 evidence that war crimes appear to have been committed and the UK supports legal PROCESSES ⚖️ to determine this while leaving it to international COURTS 🏛️ to decide on genocide ALLEGATIONS 🧐!! Israel's leaders have REJECTED 🙅 all such claims insisting their forces operate within international LAW ⚖️ but the UK's "new APPROACH 🛣️" was necessary because E1 would slice the future Palestine right in HALF ✂️!! Miliband began his statement by referencing his own JEWISH 🕎 roots and childhood visits to Israel plus recent antisemitic ATTACKS 🪓 in the UK describing himself as a "PROUD 😤 British Jew" and vowing to call out anyone questioning Israel's right to exist as a homeland for the Jewish people!! Yet the UK's Chief Rabbi called it a truly DARK 🌑 day for British Jews saying the sanctions were basically political FLAG 🏴 waving that would only EMBOLDEN 💪 those using hatred against Jews while the Board of Deputies expressed deep REGRET 😔 and urged both governments to avoid party POLITICS 🏛️ over national INTERESTS 🇬🇧!!
